bagPolicy.summary: Nebraska uses a clear bag policy. Each ticketed guest can bring one clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bag up to 12" x 6" x 12" or a one-gallon clear freezer bag, plus a small purse up to 4.5" x 6.5". Approved medical bags are allowed after inspection at any gate.

parking.summary: For Husker football games, the lots directly around Memorial Stadium are reserved for Huskers Athletic Fund donors, and overnight parking isn't allowed. Lot 9 is the main accessible parking option, and free disabled parking is available at meters on 14th and Vine, first come, first served. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Memorial Stadium. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Memorial Stadium is fully cashless and has no ATMs in or around the venue. Food and drinks bought from outside vendors are not allowed, but you can bring an empty personal water bottle to refill at the fountains inside.

accessibility.summary: Official venue guidance describes wheelchair access or accessible seating, assistive-listening support.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: For Nebraska football games, re-entry is not allowed. If you leave after entering, your ticket becomes invalid. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
